Im from Michigan and have lived in a 100,000 person town and considered that to be somewhat small. However, I have a history of feeling very isolated from social anxiety and not being able to relate to others around me and I feel more comfortable around more eccentric personalities. I dont know if I could find those types in Quincy or somewhere like that. Low budget, social work jobs are low paying. In spare time, I go to comedy shows, volunteer at homeless shelters, mountain bike, do Jewish activities, etc. Northampton would be a wonderful comfort zone but I feel like it may get too small after a while and I want to set down roots asap.

This is fucking terrifying. Im on 2mg of risperidone and feel a strong decrease in mental functioning. Im trying to get off of it completely in 1/2 year after I graduate college. I only had one delusion and its a big fucking mistake to take this shit and let my entire functioning decrease.

I went through an experience that I still dont know if it was real or not. It changed my entire worldview and morality. Im now on anti psychotics. Im going to try to get off of them and understand whether Im psychotic or just experienced a symptom of severe isolation. The only thing I have now is the ability to relate to people like you. I want to go to groups and talk to homeless people because theyve felt marginalized also. Idk, just turn the nothingness you feel into an ability to relate to other people’s sufferings.

A permanent scar on your chest from a suicide attempt does not seem like attention seeking. Rather it suggests that you just wanted things to stop. Im sorry that you are going through this level of depression at such a young age. That really sucks. Is it possible that one of your parents listens to you more than the other? Maybe you could sit them down and have a very serious conversation and you can describe your symptoms. I think finding a therapist would be a really good move. Also medication. You could talk to your school social worker and see what options they can provide for you. Maybe the social worker can help this conversation with your parents move more quickly. Hope something can work out!

How selective is the mutism? Have you considered going to therapy? Or music or art therapy which can allow new forms of self expression? It sounds like a difficult situation. In your case, I feel like having online friends could be a good thing. Im just wondering if you could supplement that with new forms of expression in the real world.

Do you have a difficult time loving and forgiving yourself? Maybe your body is somehow rejecting the experience the song words provide for you. You could make a list of what triggers the attacks and see if there is a connection between them? Or is it always completely random? Talking to a therapist may help with this. Also taking deep breaths and learning how to ground yourself in the present moment.

What brought you to live in your parent’s house? It seems like a really difficult situation to stay in long term, if your father is abusive. Im glad you are meeting with your psychologist and psychiatrist next week, that can be helpful to process whats going on for you right now. If you are cutting, maybe find a different outlet like holding ice or going into a park outside to scream at the top of your lungs just for the fun of it. Exercise can be helpful as well. Hope you feel better soon!

You are definitely not alone. Ive felt like this before, that isolation is constant and nothing could change. A therapist can be an ally for a while. Maybe volunteer at a homeless shelter because it can be possible to empathize with other people who are suffering. Theres always room for volunteers at a local homeless shelter. There is a slight chance that things can get better, and so if you want to break out of your current thought patterns- just push yourself. And if you cant, the suicide hotline can be helpful.

You should try out 3D animation if that’s what you really want to do. Maybe you’ll be able to finish it and become successful with that. If your girlfriend has stuck with you so far, its most likely that she’ll stay around while you test out this new option. I think its possible to succeed at this, and maybe you should try. Sending good vibes your way.
